metadata.data_source: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) - Sectoral Deployment of Bank Credit (Table 4 & Form VII)

sectors.name: Agriculture & Allied Activities
sectors.plainDesc: Farm loans, Kisan Credit Cards, crop cultivation, tractors, irrigation, and allied agro-processing units.

sectors.name: Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME)
sectors.plainDesc: Working capital and machinery loans for small factories, artisanal workshops, packaging, and local engineering firms.

sectors.name: Large Industry
sectors.plainDesc: Term credit to large corporate conglomerates, heavy manufacturing, cement, steel, and capital goods plants.

sectors.name: Infrastructure
sectors.plainDesc: Long-term loans for solar/thermal power plants, highways, bridges, telecom towers, airports, and seaports.

sectors.name: Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs)
sectors.plainDesc: Bank funding provided to shadow banks, microfinance institutions (MFIs), and housing finance corporations.

sectors.name: Trade (Wholesale & Retail)
sectors.plainDesc: Inventory credit and merchant lines for wholesale distributors, supermarkets, retailers, and e-commerce supply chains.

sectors.name: Commercial Real Estate (CRE)
sectors.plainDesc: Loans to real estate developers constructing IT office parks, shopping malls, hotels, and logistics warehouses.

sectors.name: Housing (Individual Mortgages)
sectors.plainDesc: Home purchase mortgages, home improvement credit, and priority residential housing loans to individuals.

sectors.name: Transport Operators
sectors.plainDesc: Financing for commercial freight trucks, logistics trailers, passenger buses, cargo vans, and taxi fleets.

sectors.name: Basic Metals & Chemical Products
sectors.plainDesc: Working capital and equipment loans for iron & steel plants, aluminum smelters, fertilizers, and industrial chemicals.
